description: Turn a photo of one real object (furniture, a product) into a textured 3D mesh, as Photo to 3D CAD on techdrawai.com: GLB, STL, OBJ, FBX and USDZ. It follows the photo's shape and colours, not exact dimensions; for a part with real sizes use text_to_cad. Starts a background job (usually one to five minutes) and returns a job_id for check_job. Costs 80 credits and requires the Studio plan; refunded if it fails.

image.description: The photo (JPG, PNG or WebP): a local file path, an http(s) URL, or a data:image URL.

textured.description: Colour textures from the photo. Default true.

name: photo_to_3d
title: Reconstruct a textured 3D model from a photo
